Yopass is a Go + Redis + OpenPGP secret-sharing website (yopass.se).
The GifOS port is a rewrite of the idea, not their backend:

- No Go server, no Redis, no accounts, no OpenID, no webhooks.
- Ciphertext lives in this file / the Invite room, on the host's
  browser. Invite is the one-time URL.
- Encryption is Web Crypto AES-GCM (optional passphrase via PBKDF2),
  not OpenPGP.js. Same job: a secret you can hand someone without
  putting it in Slack in the clear. Different bytes.

This is an unofficial port. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
